class.name: Hurtbox3D
class.brief_description: Passive damage receiver: an Area3D that active detectors find and hit.
class.description: The Hurtbox3D is attached to a character or object that can take damage. It never scans for anything itself ([member monitoring] is off) but stays monitorable so active detectors (Hitbox3D, Projectile3D) can find it through the physics space. When an attacker calls [method apply_hit], the hurtbox validates its state and emits [signal hurt] with the attacker and the standard hit-data dictionary. Connect the owning character's health system to [signal hurt] to apply damage. Place hurtboxes on a dedicated collision layer and point attacking hitboxes' [member Area3D.collision_mask] at it.

method.name: apply_hit
method.description: Accepts a hit from any attacker carrying hit data (Hitbox3D, Projectile3D, or scripted attackers). Emits [signal hurt] when active. Virtual, so C++ subclasses can intercept or transform damage.

signal.name: hurt
signal.description: Emitted when [method apply_hit] accepts a hit.
